name: Windsor.ai for Web Analytics
description: Windsor.ai for Web Analytics is a focused workspace for understanding how your site performs. It connects your web-analytics sources, Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console, so you can ask questions in plain language: compare traffic, engagement, and conversions over time; break results down by page, channel, or country; and see which search queries drive clicks, impressions, CTR, and average position. It connects only your web-analytics sources, so the tools stay on task. Read access is available on the free plan with no credit card required. Windsor.ai is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the platforms it connects to.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Windsor.ai for Web Analytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Windsor.ai for Web Analytics to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.windsor.ai/web_analytics. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Windsor.ai for Web Analytics MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Windsor.ai for Web Analytics lists 18 MCP tools, including contact_windsor, create_custom_field, create_destination_task, execute_action, get_connector_authorization_url, get_connector_connect_info, get_connectors, get_current_user, get_custom_fields, get_data, get_destination_setup_info, and get_destination_tasks.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Windsor.ai for Web Analytics?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Windsor.ai for Web Analytics in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Windsor.ai for Web Analytics MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Windsor.ai for Web Analytics requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Windsor.ai for Web Analytics?

acceptedAnswer.text: Windsor.ai for Web Analytics is developed by Windsor.ai. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
